Creates a Paystack transaction. Authentication accepts **either** a Business secret key (B2B) **or** an Application API key plus an optional `customerid` (B2C). `amount` is in major units (XOF). Use `metadata.parcelreference` to mark a parcel paid, or `metadata.fulfil="wallet"` to credit a business wallet. The response includes `authorizationurl` (hosted checkout) and `accesscode` (for the Paystack popup).
